operator_summary: OpenClaw now has a deterministic tool/protocol adapter registry. It lists which adapters are read-only, preview-only, receipt-only, candidate, future-gated, blocked, or quarantined before any runtime wiring. Tools are not authority by themselves; packages must satisfy actor, model, memory, Guardian, Operator, and receipt gates before future use.
